result.stdout:
Multi-cloud Kubernetes deployment relay. Orchestrates the full deployment lifecycle: build, deploy, promote, stage, switchover, canary, and restart across environments and clusters. via ArgoCD and GitOps.

Submodules
  service      s  Manage services: register, remove, and import.
  environment  e  Manage environments: clone and tear down.
  cluster         Manage clusters: provision, install tools, and destroy.
  config          Manage configuration: sync with organization repo.

Subcommands
  scaffold        Regenerates relay-managed Kustomize patches based on relay.json (node pools, scaling, anti-affinity). Re-runnable.
  setup           Registers clusters and repos with ArgoCD, generates Application manifests, and syncs. Re-runnable.
  deploy       d  Builds, pushes, and deploys the service to the target environment.
  promote      p  Copies a deployment from one environment to another (e.g., dev to prod).
  stage           Deploys a new version to the standby slot for verification before switching live traffic.
  switchover      Switches live traffic to the staged version instantly, with no downtime.
  canary       c  Sends a percentage of live traffic to the staged version for gradual rollout.
  restart      r  Restarts the service across all clusters in the environment.

Options
  --config    -c  (Default: .relay/relay.json) -- Path to the platform configuration file.
  --service   -s  (Default: ) -- Target service name. Auto-detected from .NET project file if empty.
